ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite imagery monitoring tool that detects unauthorized industrial land usage and environmental compliance violations for state industrial development corporations.
ideas.title: EcoCompliant-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors a proven winner that solved regional industrial compliance challenges using geo-spatial AI, aligning with the industry-focused mandate of SIT Pune hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-backed anti-money laundering risk detection platform that uses graph intelligence and LightGBM to flag suspicious financial transaction networks in real-time.
ideas.title: RiskGraph AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies heavy graph analytics and rigorous ML to solve an authentic industry problem, catching the eye of financial and corporate judges looking for production-grade security logic.

ideas.pitch: A Poisson regression and GAM forecasting tool designed to predict AI safety and governance incidents with calibrated rolling backtests and prediction intervals.
ideas.title: IncidentCast
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuine statistical rigor and mathematical modeling beyond simple wrapper APIs, impressing judges looking for deep technical depth in an 8-hour sprint.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient acquisition and trust engine built for specialized medical clinics to automatically synthesize patient testimonials, verify credentials, and draft localized outreach.
ideas.title: ClinicTrust AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a clear commercial use case with immediate ROI for local businesses, a profile that traditionally wins time-constrained sprints focused on practical utility.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven video intelligence engine that ingests unstructured campus lecture and industry seminar recordings to convert them into a fully searchable, queryable database.
ideas.title: VideoIntelli Search
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate productivity bottleneck for educational and enterprise environments using multimodal data pipelines, making it instantly relatable to institutional judges.
